title: LBC Boston Developing 250,000 SF to Create Allston Green
firm_sentence: Working with Prellwitz Chilinkski Associates, Inc./PCA of Cambridge, the design strategically places three buildings and two green spaces on the site.
address_sentence: Located at 20 Linden Street and named Allston Green, the $140 million, 250,000 SF complex features three buildings on approximately two acres and 350 housing units.
